rows.section: Income tax (porez na dohodak) 2026: default rates
rows.label: Lower rate: tax base up to the threshold
rows.basis: Annual tax base (income less contributions and the personal allowance), residents
rows.note: Every city and municipality sets its own lower and higher rate within statutory limits; these 20% and 30% rates apply where it has made no decision (489 of 556 units in 2026). The rates of the taxpayer's place of residence apply. In payroll the threshold is €5,000 a month. Lowest rates 15% / 25%, highest 23% / 33% (City of Zagreb).

rows.value: Yes: non-EU/EEA nationals working through communication technology for a company (or their own company) not registered in Croatia; up to 18 months; new application 6 months after expiry

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital-nomad stay: means of subsistence per month (2.5 × the average monthly net salary of the previous year)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital-nomad stay: tax consequence
